review_artifacts.scope: 1 Hz chronological contact samples across each complete clip, plus predefined native-size keys. This is sampled visual review, not inspection of every encoded frame or continuous real-time playback. Thumbnail fps filter selects/duplicates only for contact sheets; source videos remain unchanged. Source MP4 packet PTS are sorted into presentation order and checked against declared frame count; full clips are decoded for contact extraction.

review_decision.contact_review: One chronological sample per second through all three 184-second recordings. Standard CPU sheets were inspected first; all four are byte-identical to the completed GPU-assisted extraction. Reduced and neural sheets were inspected from the completed extraction. Sheet display was resized by the review tool to approximately 1728x1440 or 1843x1344.
review_decision.native_key_review: All 24 predefined 2560x1440 keys inspected with original-resolution image delivery. Initial downscaled standard keys were subsequently inspected again at original resolution.
observations: All sampled frames show the expected repeated road traversal and turns; no collision or interruption is visible at the sampled cadence.
Buildings, openings, gate bars, roadside barriers, lamp posts, road signs and vegetation retain recognizable scene identity in the reviewed keys. Separate passes are not pixel-aligned.
Neural output mainly lifts midtone brightness, including road, walls and vegetation. No substantial change toward photographic materials or lighting is demonstrated.
Peripheral movement blur is visible in source and enhanced keys, especially during turns; the reduced render also retains coarse/aliased fine details. These are not repaired by the brightness pass.
Brightening falls off toward guarded screen margins. Existing shade and roof detail remain visible in the selected keys; this is not a quantified target-visibility result.
review_decision.scope_limit: Sampled images can exclude gross sampled failures but cannot establish frame-to-frame flicker, input responsiveness, hidden opponents or universal geometry/visibility preservation. Full video remains available at original elapsed speed.
review_decision.extraction_recovery: Slow CPU extraction was intentionally stopped with partial artifacts retained. Complete extraction uses D3D11VA requested decoding and sorted packet PTS; the standard timestamp array exactly matches the earlier decoded-frame timestamps. GPU decoding was requested, not independently profiled.

operational_recovery.initial_neural: sustained-neural-v1 completed zero companion frames; recorder exited 2 because no companion capture window was visible. No enhanced video exists. Foreground was not logged, so the failure cause is not conclusively isolated.
operational_recovery.observed_recovery: During sustained-standard-v2, Windows inspection found a foreground Crash Reporter belonging to the retained foliage-walk-pilot-v2 crash. First Close click failed with coordinate input geometry unavailable; refreshed activation and one retry closed it. No report was submitted. Game focus was then restored. This is consistent with the companion inactivity gate, not proof of earlier foreground ownership.
operational_recovery.excluded_run: sustained-standard-v2 is excluded from the final controlled comparison because these UI interventions occurred during its measurement. It is retained with its own full analysis and video. Selection is based on intervention, not measured speed.
operational_recovery.startup_guards: The driver now records foreground PID changes, requires the game foreground before starting measurements and requires populated companion frame evidence before attempting enhanced recording. It never forces focus or bypasses the companion guard. Game activation through the Windows tool occurs only before measurement.
operational_recovery.budget: Original deadline 2026-09-10T11:51:05Z retained; no route or numeric-gate changes and no further reruns authorized by this experiment.

sparse_telemetry_diagnostic.method: Same dense recorded pass: interpolate directions at integer seconds from all rows versus every tenth row; normalize interpolated vectors. No cross-run fit. Approximate 1 Hz decimation is not exactly the earlier logging schedule.
sparse_telemetry_diagnostic.limit: Demonstrates sparse logging alone can produce a failed direction gate at a piecewise turn boundary. Does not prove the cause of every earlier cross-pass difference.

driver_retention: Initial pilot and standard driver copies were retained after their sessions. Later revisions added automatic driver retention, an explicit plan argument, foreground logging and startup guards after the zero-frame failure. All three final controlled passes use the same retained driver and validated 10 Hz addon; model and shader are unchanged.
runtime_binary_limit: Current diagnostic companion binary is measured with DXGI statistics disabled. Its model, shader and controls are unchanged; the earlier independently verified downloadable package is not rebuilt in this experiment.
publication_redaction: Machine roots and profile account identifiers are replaced in the published copy. Original local files and their hashes are retained.
